split.fit: nonvalidation noncoast single-wheel data; abs speed >=1 rad/s; nonoverlapping 50ms integral windows
split.holdout: all coast and predeclared validation segments, including both-wheel cases
split.low_speed: diagnostic only; excluded from parameter fitting

limitations: Airborne data identify nominal effective inertia and moving resistance, not tyre friction or loaded high-speed limits.
Total J includes existing CAD axial inertia; additional armature must replace the old extra armature, not accumulate with it.
Low-speed breakaway, direction history and current-to-shaft-torque lag are not independently identified.
Recorded-current diagnostics are not actuator lag parameters.
Native Isaac inertia/friction API and existing actuator_response evidence must be revalidated before frozen contract release.

wheels.bootstrap_scope: conditional segment resampling sensitivity, not absolute physical uncertainty
